scope: Reference bone geometry and model coordinates only. No rig, skin weights or runtime assets changed.
limitations: Arm26 groups ulna, radius and hand as one rigid body; it does not supply an independent pronation/supination mechanism.
Body registration, bone clearance and anatomical landmark review are required before any character integration.
MoBL-ARMS model was not imported; its published non-commercial restriction is unsuitable as an assumed Simple Trainer asset license.
